device: Pixel Android API 35 emulator, Hermes, Expo development build
scope: Follow-up experiments on measured globe projection and path emission hotspots
method: Original and candidate loaded in the same runtime. Six identical cameras, 70 degree clip, land plus borders, six warmup pairs followed by 48 measured pairs per tier. Alternate which implementation runs first; yield between pairs. Compare median per-pair candidate/original ratios rather than unrelated wall-clock sessions.
successCriteria: Keep only a repeatable useful reduction without a material regression in another normal camera workload, and preserve native paths.

experiments.name: Early straight-chord return from emitPoint
experiments.decision: Discarded: only a few percent faster, insufficient evidence for additional branch and code.

experiments.name: Select straight/resampled emitter once per draw
experiments.decision: Discarded: effectively flat, with regional work slightly regressing.

experiments.name: Buffer contours into native SkPathBuilder.addPoly calls
experiments.decision: Discarded: median paired ratios showed 55%/31%/29% more time for motion/overview/regional, despite identical native SVG paths.

experiments.name: Cache cap inside/outside cosine thresholds until clip angle changes
experiments.decision: Discarded: first fixed-angle motion run gained ~6%, repeat only ~1%; changing-angle motion regressed ~8%. Not worth extra per-part fields, setup, and invalidation.

measurementLimits: No-op sink used for emitter/cap experiments. Real native Skia builders used for addPoly experiment, with native SVG equality checked across six cameras per tier. These are controlled kernel/path construction benchmarks, not screen FPS.

validation.emitterEarlyReturn: Existing 10-test d3 equivalence suite passed; candidate subsequently reverted.
validation.retainedSource: ortho-stream.ts restored byte-for-byte to snapshot taken at this round's start, retaining the earlier fully-inside fast path.
validation.temporaryInstrumentation: Reference module, benchmark registration, and runtime globals removed by reload.

afterProfile.combinedReport: Attempted; no React commits to correlate.

finalVerification.profileInterpretation: Before and after native recordings were dominated by emulator/kernel GPU transport. Camera state and native overhead vary; do not attribute the change in native hang counts to this adapter optimization. Controlled paired native path construction runs support the reported improvement.

quality.note: One test needs to spawn a Node fixture; sandbox EPERM was resolved by rerunning that test outside the sandbox with the existing npm test approval.

ui.globeDrag: passed, four directions, final clean source
ui.openClose: story expansion and Android-back collapse passed

finalVerification.flowRepair: Increased deck accessibility assertion timeout from 5 to 15 seconds after a tree-read timeout; expected story assertions unchanged.
finalVerification.additionalBugFix: See perf/read-progress-regression-20261015.json for the subsequent read-history investigation requested by the user.
finalVerification.cleanup: Temporary reference modules and app registrations deleted; benchmark globals removed by clean reload/cold restart. Earlier ortho-stream fast-path source preserved byte for byte.

result: Kept direct bound Skia path methods after repeatable gains and exact native path equality. Discarded the emitter, batching and cap cache candidates; prior successful improvements preserved.

kept.change: Bind each native Skia path builder's moveTo, lineTo, conicTo and close methods once, cache in a WeakMap, and point the stable context's methods directly at those bindings when retargeting. Removes the JS wrapper, receiver guard and Function.call from each emitted point.
kept.tests: __tests__/skia-path-context.test.ts: no target, all commands retarget with native receiver intact, independent contexts
kept.interpretation: Median paired motion ratios 0.870 and 0.846 (13–15% faster); overview 0.872 and 0.891 (11–13%); regional 0.912 and 0.929 (7–9%). Both implementations compiled by Metro and run together against the same geometry and native Skia builders, with setPath retargeting included.
kept.correctness: Native SVG strings matched across six cameras per tier in each run. Separate native probe confirmed curves, arcs, close aliases and switching between reused builders match the original.
kept.limitations: Android development emulator only. These are native path construction timings, not screen FPS. React commit capture on the globe gesture baseline yielded zero commits as expected for imperative drawing. Native profile is dominated by emulator GPU transport; no end-to-end speed claim.

beforeProfile.combinedReport: Attempted; tool returned no React commit data.

kept.instrumentationIncident: One benchmark evaluation was issued before Skia's native installation had completed after reload, causing SkiaApi initialization errors. Recovered with a cold app restart and waited for nativeSkiaReady/mainReady before measurement. This failed evaluation is excluded from timing data.
